# pkc/pkgfile

> pkc: package files — parse sections, patterns and emit headers (port of internal/pkgfile).

truck [pkc](../pkc.md) · [source](../../../registry/pkc/pkgfile.pkg)

`pf_parse(name, origin, src)` returns a `ptr PfFile`, or `null` with
`pk_err` set to the same message the Go compiler gives. `pf_dump(f)`
renders the `dump pkg` format of [docs/dumps.md](../../dumps.md).

## Needs

- [std](../std.md)
- [rt](../rt.md)
- [pkc/util](util.md)

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
struct PfFile
  name: str
  origin: str
  doc: str
  doc_body: ptr Vec
  needs: ptr Vec
  types: ptr Vec
  truck: ptr Vec
  is_truck: bool
  syntax: ptr Vec
  expand: ptr Vec
  code: ptr Vec
  code_at: int
  emits: ptr Vec
  data: ptr Vec
  support: ptr Vec
end

struct PfType
  name: str
  size: int
end

struct PfSyntax
  kind: str
  prec: int
  right: bool
  place: bool
  ret: bool
  loop: bool
  inloop: bool
  top: bool
  patterns: ptr Vec
  line: int
end

struct PfPattern
  elems: ptr Vec
  result: str
  line: int
end

struct PfElem
  lit: str
  slot: ptr PfSlot
  optional: ptr Vec
  repeat: bool
end

struct PfSlot
  name: str
  kind: str
  arg: str
  follow: ptr Vec
end

struct PfEmit
  section: str
  cond: ptr PfCond
  lines: ptr Vec
  line: int
end

struct PfCond
  slot: str
  op: str
  arg: str
end

fn pf_kind(name: str) -> str
  let i = len(name) - 1
  while i >= 0
    if name[i] == '/'
      return str_slice(name, i + 1, len(name))
    end
    i = i - 1
  end
  return name
end

fn pf_is_section(kw: str) -> bool
  return kw == "doc" || kw == "needs" || kw == "type" || kw == "truck" || kw == "syntax" || kw == "expand" || kw == "code" || kw == "emit" || kw == "data" || kw == "support"
end

fn pf_is_slot_kind(k: str) -> bool
  return k == "expr" || k == "block" || k == "newvar" || k == "var" || k == "ident" || k == "func" || k == "newfunc" || k == "args" || k == "params" || k == "type" || k == "place" || k == "field" || k == "newtype" || k == "fields" || k == "newglobal" || k == "newconst"
end

fn pf_is_syntax_kind(k: str) -> bool
  return k == "statement" || k == "function" || k == "struct" || k == "expr" || k == "infix" || k == "prefix" || k == "postfix"
end

fn pf_errf(origin: str, line: int, msg: str) -> ptr PfFile
  pk_err = u_cat4(origin, ":", str_from_int(line), u_cat(": ", msg))
  return null
end

fn pf_dedent(s: str) -> str
  if len(s) > 0 && s[0] == '\t'
    return str_slice(s, 1, len(s))
  end
  let i = 0
  while i < 2 && i < len(s) && s[i] == ' '
    i = i + 1
  end
  return str_slice(s, i, len(s))
end

fn pf_trim_blank_tail(v: ptr Vec)
  while vec_len(v) > 0 && u_get(v, vec_len(v) - 1) == ""
    vec_pop(v)
  end
end

fn pf_parse(name: str, origin: str, src: str) -> ptr PfFile
  let f = new PfFile
  f.name = name
  f.origin = origin
  f.doc = ""
  f.doc_body = vec_new()
  f.needs = vec_new()
  f.types = vec_new()
  f.truck = vec_new()
  f.syntax = vec_new()
  f.emits = vec_new()
  f.data = vec_new()
  f.support = vec_new()
  let lines = u_split(u_replace(src, "\r\n", "\n"), '\n')
  let cur: ptr Vec = null
  let cur_syn: ptr PfSyntax = null
  let in_doc = false
  let in_code = false
  for idx = 0 to vec_len(lines) - 1
    let ln = idx + 1
    let raw = u_get(lines, idx)
    let trimmed = u_trim(raw)
    let indented = raw == "" || raw[0] == ' ' || raw[0] == '\t'
    if in_code && indented
      if trimmed == ""
        u_push(f.code, "")
      else
        u_push(f.code, pf_dedent(raw))
      end
      continue
    end
    if in_doc && indented
      if trimmed == ""
        u_push(f.doc_body, "")
      else
        u_push(f.doc_body, pf_dedent(raw))
      end
      continue
    end
    if trimmed == "" || str_starts(trimmed, "//")
      continue
    end
    if !indented
      let fields = u_fields(trimmed)
      let kw = u_get(fields, 0)
      if !pf_is_section(kw)
        return pf_errf(origin, ln, u_cat3("unknown section ", u_quote(kw), " (expected one of doc, needs, type, truck, syntax, expand, code, emit, data, support)"))
      end
      cur = null
      cur_syn = null
      in_doc = kw == "doc"
      in_code = kw == "code"
      if kw == "doc"
        f.doc = u_trim(u_after(trimmed, "doc"))
      elif kw == "needs"
        for i = 1 to vec_len(fields) - 1
          u_push(f.needs, u_get(fields, i))
        end
      elif kw == "type"
        if vec_len(fields) != 3
          return pf_errf(origin, ln, "use: type <name> <size in bytes>")
        end
        let ok = false
        let size = u_atoi(u_get(fields, 2), &ok)
        if !ok || (size != 1 && size != 8)
          return pf_errf(origin, ln, "type size must be 1 or 8 bytes")
        end
        let t = new PfType
        t.name = u_get(fields, 1)
        t.size = size
        vec_push(f.types, t as int)
      elif kw == "truck"
        f.is_truck = true
        cur = f.truck
      elif kw == "syntax"
        let s = pf_syntax_header(fields)
        if s == null
          return pf_errf(origin, ln, pk_err)
        end
        s.line = ln
        vec_push(f.syntax, s as int)
        cur_syn = s
      elif kw == "code"
        if f.code != null
          return pf_errf(origin, ln, "only one code section is allowed")
        end
        f.code = vec_new()
        f.code_at = ln + 1
      elif kw == "expand"
        if f.expand != null
          return pf_errf(origin, ln, "only one expand section is allowed")
        end
        f.expand = vec_new()
        cur = f.expand
      elif kw == "emit"
        let e = pf_emit_header(fields)
        if e == null
          return pf_errf(origin, ln, pk_err)
        end
        e.line = ln
        vec_push(f.emits, e as int)
        cur = e.lines
      elif kw == "data"
        cur = f.data
      elif kw == "support"
        cur = f.support
      end
      continue
    end
    if cur_syn != null
      let p = pf_parse_pattern(trimmed)
      if p == null
        return pf_errf(origin, ln, pk_err)
      end
      p.line = ln
      if !pf_check_pattern(cur_syn, p)
        return pf_errf(origin, ln, pk_err)
      end
      vec_push(cur_syn.patterns, p as int)
    elif cur != null
      u_push(cur, trimmed)
    else
      return pf_errf(origin, ln, "indented line outside of a section")
    end
  end
  pf_trim_blank_tail(f.doc_body)
  if f.code != null
    pf_trim_blank_tail(f.code)
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(f.syntax) - 1
    let s = vec_get(f.syntax, i) as ptr PfSyntax
    if vec_len(s.patterns) == 0
      return pf_errf(origin, s.line, "syntax section has no patterns")
    end
  end
  return f
end

fn pf_syntax_header(fields: ptr Vec) -> ptr PfSyntax
  if vec_len(fields) < 2 || !pf_is_syntax_kind(u_get(fields, 1))
    u_fail("syntax needs a kind: statement, function, struct, expr, infix, prefix or postfix")
    return null
  end
  let s = new PfSyntax
  s.kind = u_get(fields, 1)
  s.patterns = vec_new()
  for i = 2 to vec_len(fields) - 1
    let a = u_get(fields, i)
    if a == "left"
    elif a == "right"
      s.right = true
    elif a == "place"
      s.place = true
    elif a == "return"
      s.ret = true
    elif a == "loop"
      s.loop = true
    elif a == "inloop"
      s.inloop = true
    elif a == "top"
      s.top = true
    else
      let ok = false
      let n = u_atoi(a, &ok)
      if !ok
        u_fail(u_cat3("unexpected ", u_quote(a), " in syntax header"))
        return null
      end
      s.prec = n
    end
  end
  if (s.kind == "infix" || s.kind == "prefix" || s.kind == "postfix") && s.prec == 0
    u_fail(u_cat(s.kind, " syntax needs a precedence (a positive number)"))
    return null
  end
  return s
end

fn pf_emit_header(fields: ptr Vec) -> ptr PfEmit
  let e = new PfEmit
  e.section = ""
  e.lines = vec_new()
  let i = 1
  if vec_len(fields) > 1 && u_get(fields, 1) != "when"
    e.section = u_get(fields, 1)
    i = 2
  end
  let n = vec_len(fields) - i
  if n == 0
    return e
  end
  if u_get(fields, i) != "when"
    u_fail("expected 'when' in emit header")
    return null
  end
  i = i + 1
  n = n - 1
  let c = new PfCond
  c.arg = ""
  if n == 3 && (u_get(fields, i + 1) == "is" || u_get(fields, i + 1) == "has" || u_get(fields, i + 1) == "size" || u_get(fields, i + 1) == "count")
    c.slot = u_get(fields, i)
    c.op = u_get(fields, i + 1)
    c.arg = u_get(fields, i + 2)
  elif n == 2 && (u_get(fields, i + 1) == "simple" || u_get(fields, i + 1) == "empty" || u_get(fields, i + 1) == "missing")
    c.slot = u_get(fields, i)
    c.op = u_get(fields, i + 1)
  elif n == 2
    c.slot = u_get(fields, i)
    c.op = "type"
    c.arg = u_get(fields, i + 1)
  else
    u_fail("bad condition; use: when <slot> <type> | <slot> is <kind> | <slot> has <section> | <slot> size <n> | <slot> count <n> | <slot> simple | <slot> empty | <slot> missing")
    return null
  end
  e.cond = c
  return e
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- patterns

fn pf_pattern_tokens(s: str) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  let i = 0
  while i < len(s)
    let c = s[i]
    if c == ' ' || c == '\t'
      i = i + 1
    elif c == '[' || c == ']'
      u_push(out, str_slice(s, i, i + 1))
      i = i + 1
    elif c == '{'
      let depth = 0
      let j = i
      while j < len(s)
        if s[j] == '{'
          depth = depth + 1
        elif s[j] == '}'
          depth = depth - 1
          if depth == 0
            break
          end
        end
        j = j + 1
      end
      if j >= len(s)
        u_fail("unterminated slot in pattern")
        return null
      end
      u_push(out, str_slice(s, i, j + 1))
      i = j + 1
    elif c == '\\' && i + 1 < len(s)
      let j = i + 1
      while j < len(s) && s[j] != ' ' && s[j] != '\t'
        j = j + 1
      end
      u_push(out, u_cat("\x00", str_slice(s, i + 1, j)))
      i = j
    else
      let j = i
      while j < len(s) && s[j] != ' ' && s[j] != '\t' && s[j] != '[' && s[j] != ']' && s[j] != '{'
        j = j + 1
      end
      u_push(out, str_slice(s, i, j))
      i = j
    end
  end
  return out
end

fn pf_parse_pattern(s: str) -> ptr PfPattern
  let toks = pf_pattern_tokens(s)
  if toks == null
    return null
  end
  let p = new PfPattern
  p.result = ""
  let i = vec_len(toks) - 2
  while i >= 0
    if u_get(toks, i) != "->"
      i = i - 1
      continue
    end
    let is_type = true
    for j = i + 1 to vec_len(toks) - 1
      let t = u_get(toks, j)
      if u_has(t, ":") || str_starts(t, "\x00")
        is_type = false
      end
    end
    if is_type
      let res = u_join_from(toks, i + 1, " ")
      p.result = u_replace(u_replace(res, "[ ", "["), " ]", "]")
      let cut = vec_new()
      for j = 0 to i - 1
        u_push(cut, u_get(toks, j))
      end
      toks = cut
    end
    break
  end
  let pos = 0
  let elems = pf_parse_elems(toks, &pos, false)
  if elems == null
    return null
  end
  if pos < vec_len(toks)
    u_fail("unbalanced ']' in pattern")
    return null
  end
  if vec_len(elems) == 0
    u_fail("empty pattern")
    return null
  end
  p.elems = elems
  return p
end

// pf_parse_elems reads elements from toks starting at *pos; inside a group
// it stops after the closing ']'.
fn pf_parse_elems(toks: ptr Vec, pos: ptr int, in_group: bool) -> ptr Vec
  let elems = vec_new()
  while *pos < vec_len(toks)
    let t = u_get(toks, *pos)
    *pos = *pos + 1
    if t == "["
      let group = pf_parse_elems(toks, pos, true)
      if group == null
        return null
      end
      if vec_len(group) == 0 || (vec_get(group, 0) as ptr PfElem).lit == ""
        u_fail("an optional group must start with a literal")
        return null
      end
      let e = new PfElem
      e.lit = ""
      e.optional = group
      if *pos < vec_len(toks) && u_get(toks, *pos) == "*"
        e.repeat = true
        *pos = *pos + 1
      end
      vec_push(elems, e as int)
    elif t == "]"
      if !in_group
        u_fail("unbalanced ']' in pattern")
        return null
      end
      return elems
    elif str_starts(t, "{")
      let sl = pf_parse_slot(t)
      if sl == null
        return null
      end
      let e = new PfElem
      e.lit = ""
      e.slot = sl
      vec_push(elems, e as int)
    else
      let e = new PfElem
      e.lit = u_after(t, "\x00")
      vec_push(elems, e as int)
    end
  end
  if in_group
    u_fail("unclosed '[' in pattern")
    return null
  end
  return elems
end

fn pf_parse_slot(t: str) -> ptr PfSlot
  let body = str_slice(t, 1, len(t))
  if str_ends(body, "}")
    body = str_slice(body, 0, len(body) - 1)
  end
  let colon = str_find_byte(body, ':', 0)
  if colon < 0
    u_fail(u_cat3("slot ", t, " needs a kind, e.g. {name: expr}"))
    return null
  end
  let fields = u_fields(str_slice(body, colon + 1, len(body)))
  if vec_len(fields) == 0 || !pf_is_slot_kind(u_get(fields, 0))
    u_fail(u_cat3("slot ", t, ": unknown kind (expr, block, newvar, var, ident, func, newfunc, args, params)"))
    return null
  end
  let s = new PfSlot
  s.name = u_trim(str_slice(body, 0, colon))
  s.kind = u_get(fields, 0)
  s.arg = u_join_from(fields, 1, " ")
  if (s.kind == "newvar" || s.kind == "field") && s.arg != ""
    if !str_starts(s.arg, "of ")
      u_fail(u_cat4("slot ", t, ": ", u_cat(s.kind, " takes 'of <slot>'")))
      return null
    end
    s.arg = u_trim(str_slice(s.arg, 3, len(s.arg)))
  end
  if s.kind == "field" && s.arg == ""
    u_fail(u_cat3("slot ", t, ": field needs 'of <slot>', the expression whose field it is"))
    return null
  end
  return s
end

fn pf_elem(v: ptr Vec, i: int) -> ptr PfElem
  return vec_get(v, i) as ptr PfElem
end

fn pf_is_expr(e: ptr PfElem) -> bool
  return e.slot != null && e.slot.kind == "expr"
end

fn pf_check_pattern(s: ptr PfSyntax, p: ptr PfPattern) -> bool
  let es = p.elems
  let n = vec_len(es)
  if s.kind == "infix"
    if n != 3 || !pf_is_expr(pf_elem(es, 0)) || pf_elem(es, 1).lit == "" || !pf_is_expr(pf_elem(es, 2))
      return u_fail("infix pattern must look like {a: expr} OP {b: expr}")
    end
  elif s.kind == "prefix"
    if n != 2 || pf_elem(es, 0).lit == "" || !(pf_is_expr(pf_elem(es, 1)) || pf_elem(es, 1).slot != null && pf_elem(es, 1).slot.kind == "place")
      return u_fail("prefix pattern must look like OP {a: expr}")
    end
  elif s.kind == "postfix"
    if n < 2 || !pf_is_expr(pf_elem(es, 0)) || pf_elem(es, 1).lit == ""
      return u_fail("postfix pattern must look like {a: expr} OP ...")
    end
  end
  let closers = vec_new()
  return pf_block_closers(es, vec_new(), closers)
end

// pf_follow lists the literals that can come right after es[i], given what
// can follow the whole list.
fn pf_follow(es: ptr Vec, i: int, after: ptr Vec) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  for j = i + 1 to vec_len(es) - 1
    let e = pf_elem(es, j)
    if e.lit != ""
      u_push(out, e.lit)
      return out
    elif e.optional != null
      u_push(out, pf_elem(e.optional, 0).lit)
    else
      return out
    end
  end
  for j = 0 to vec_len(after) - 1
    u_push(out, u_get(after, j))
  end
  return out
end

// pf_block_closers records each block and fields slot's follow set, and
// collects them all into out.
fn pf_block_closers(es: ptr Vec, after: ptr Vec, out: ptr Vec) -> bool
  for i = 0 to vec_len(es) - 1
    let e = pf_elem(es, i)
    if e.optional != null
      let then_ = pf_follow(es, i, after)
      if e.repeat
        let first = vec_new()
        u_push(first, pf_elem(e.optional, 0).lit)
        for j = 0 to vec_len(then_) - 1
          u_push(first, u_get(then_, j))
        end
        then_ = first
      end
      if !pf_block_closers(e.optional, then_, out)
        return false
      end
    end
    if e.slot != null && (e.slot.kind == "block" || e.slot.kind == "fields")
      let f = pf_follow(es, i, after)
      if vec_len(f) == 0
        return u_fail(u_cat4(e.slot.kind, " slot {", e.slot.name, "} must be followed by a literal (like 'end')"))
      end
      e.slot.follow = f
      for j = 0 to vec_len(f) - 1
        u_push(out, u_get(f, j))
      end
    end
  end
  return true
end

fn pf_literals_into(es: ptr Vec, out: ptr Vec)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(es) - 1
    let e = pf_elem(es, i)
    if e.lit != ""
      u_push(out, e.lit)
    end
    if e.optional != null
      pf_literals_into(e.optional, out)
    end
  end
end

// pf_literals lists every literal of a pattern, including groups.
fn pf_literals(p: ptr PfPattern) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  pf_literals_into(p.elems, out)
  return out
end

// pf_closers lists the literals that can directly follow a block slot.
fn pf_closers(p: ptr PfPattern) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  pf_block_closers(p.elems, vec_new(), out)
  return out
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- dump

fn pf_elems_string(es: ptr Vec) -> str
  let parts = vec_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(es) - 1
    let e = pf_elem(es, i)
    if e.lit != ""
      u_push(parts, e.lit)
    elif e.slot != null
      let s = u_cat3(e.slot.name, ": ", e.slot.kind)
      if (e.slot.kind == "newvar" || e.slot.kind == "field") && e.slot.arg != ""
        s = u_cat3(s, " of ", e.slot.arg)
      elif e.slot.arg != ""
        s = u_cat3(s, " ", e.slot.arg)
      end
      u_push(parts, u_cat3("{", s, "}"))
    elif e.optional != null
      let g = u_cat3("[ ", pf_elems_string(e.optional), " ]")
      if e.repeat
        g = u_cat(g, "*")
      end
      u_push(parts, g)
    end
  end
  return u_join(parts, " ")
end

fn pf_pattern_string(p: ptr PfPattern) -> str
  let out = pf_elems_string(p.elems)
  if p.result != ""
    out = u_cat3(out, " -> ", p.result)
  end
  return out
end

// pf_dquote renders a string for dumps: printable ASCII other than " and
// \ as is, every other byte as \xHH.
fn pf_dquote(s: str) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  sb_byte(b, '"')
  for i = 0 to len(s) - 1
    let c = s[i]
    if c >= ' ' && c <= '~' && c != '"' && c != '\\'
      sb_byte(b, c)
    else
      sb_add(b, "\\x")
      u_hex(b, c as int)
    end
  end
  sb_byte(b, '"')
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn pf_dump_body(b: ptr StrBuf, lines: ptr Vec)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(lines) - 1
    let l = u_get(lines, i)
    if l == ""
      sb_add(b, "  |\n")
    else
      sb_add(b, "  | ")
      sb_add(b, l)
      sb_byte(b, '\n')
    end
  end
end

fn pf_dump(f: ptr PfFile) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  sb_add(b, u_cat3("package ", f.name, "\n"))
  sb_add(b, u_cat3("doc ", pf_dquote(f.doc), "\n"))
  pf_dump_body(b, f.doc_body)
  if vec_len(f.needs) > 0
    sb_add(b, u_cat3("needs ", u_join(f.needs, " "), "\n"))
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(f.types) - 1
    let t = vec_get(f.types, i) as ptr PfType
    sb_add(b, u_cat4("type ", t.name, " ", u_cat(str_from_int(t.size), "\n")))
  end
  if f.is_truck
    sb_add(b, u_cat3("truck ", u_join(f.truck, " "), "\n"))
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(f.syntax) - 1
    let s = vec_get(f.syntax, i) as ptr PfSyntax
    let assoc = "left"
    if s.right
      assoc = "right"
    end
    sb_add(b, u_cat4("syntax ", s.kind, " prec=", str_from_int(s.prec)))
    sb_add(b, u_cat(" assoc=", assoc))
    if s.place
      sb_add(b, " place")
    end
    if s.ret
      sb_add(b, " return")
    end
    if s.loop
      sb_add(b, " loop")
    end
    if s.inloop
      sb_add(b, " inloop")
    end
    if s.top
      sb_add(b, " top")
    end
    sb_byte(b, '\n')
    for j = 0 to vec_len(s.patterns) - 1
      sb_add(b, u_cat3("  pattern ", pf_pattern_string(vec_get(s.patterns, j) as ptr PfPattern), "\n"))
    end
  end
  if f.expand != null
    sb_add(b, "expand\n")
    pf_dump_body(b, f.expand)
  end
  if f.code != null
    sb_add(b, "code\n")
    pf_dump_body(b, f.code)
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(f.emits) - 1
    let e = vec_get(f.emits, i) as ptr PfEmit
    sb_add(b, u_cat("emit section=", pf_dquote(e.section)))
    if e.cond != null
      sb_add(b, u_cat4(" when slot=", e.cond.slot, " op=", e.cond.op))
      sb_add(b, u_cat(" arg=", pf_dquote(e.cond.arg)))
    end
    sb_byte(b, '\n')
    pf_dump_body(b, e.lines)
  end
  if vec_len(f.data) > 0
    sb_add(b, "data\n")
    pf_dump_body(b, f.data)
  end
  if vec_len(f.support) > 0
    sb_add(b, "support\n")
    pf_dump_body(b, f.support)
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end
```
